title: Decay + archive
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

Unverified lessons that haven't been cited or surfaced within a time window get auto-archived. Archived lessons stop surfacing but aren't deleted — recoverable if the pattern becomes relevant again.

`LessonsDb::archive_decayed(window: Duration)` bulk-archives lessons where: `verified = false AND last_cited IS NULL AND (last_surfaced IS NULL OR last_surfaced < now - window) AND created_at < now - window`. The `last_surfaced` timestamp is updated by `query_for_context()` whenever a lesson is included in results.

This provides the `archive_decayed()` operation that vidhi-reflect will call during its pruning passes. It can also be exposed as a maintenance tool if needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `last_surfaced` updated when a lesson is included in query results
- [ ] `archive_decayed(window)` archives unverified lessons past the window
- [ ] Archived lessons do not appear in `query_for_context()` results
- [ ] Archived lessons are still queryable via `sutra_lessons` with an explicit filter
- [ ] Verified lessons are never auto-archived regardless of surfacing/citation activity
- [ ] Tests: decay window logic, archive excludes from surfacing, verified immunity

## Blocked by

- sutra/158 — Confidence lifecycle + surfacing priority

execution_record: Straightforward implementation. Most acceptance criteria (last_surfaced updates, archived exclusion from query_for_context) were already in place from sutra/158. New code: archive_decayed() method, include_archived on search/sutra_lessons, 5 tests. One minor fix during testing: empty WHERE clause when include_archived=true with no other filters.
